name: voice
description: Voice memos: an audio file the person attaches to a post (the dashboard's record button, a phone recorder, a WhatsApp or Telegram note) is transcribed on this machine with faster-whisper large-v3-turbo (GPU when there is one, else CPU), summarized (gist, points, asks) by Sonnet, and answered in the same thread with the full transcript attached. Installed by default on a new Hive (or `voice setup`).
